agents.name: Priya

recap:
Priya opened with a plan: a big fish, side-on. She laid the start and the lead-in, while Leo took the bottom curve and Tom the top. Maya built the lower prong of the tail, and Priya took the upper one. Then came the bump. A run of Leo's belly went down beside Maya's prong, and the team stood it back up.

The back curve gave them the most trouble. Tom reported that the line "turns too sharply" near the top and a domino "sits off to the side." His spare dominoes ran out before the last one, so Maya pulled pale tip dominoes to free more. Priya straightened the bend in the final minutes, while Leo's eye stayed pale at the lead-in.

With time nearly up, Maya called it: "hands off everyone, let it be." When the start fell, 133 of 180 dominoes went down. Everyone called it a fish. Blind judges guessed a road map, a tree, or a cable.
